BUG (CONFIRMED, dom/html/HTMLCanvasElement.cpp:1554 tests drawn->GetType() == SurfaceType::RECORDING; gfx/layers/ipc/CanvasChild.cpp:139 returns CANVAS_RECORDING from GetType() and its GetUnderlyingType() returns mRecordedSurface->GetType(); the sibling test at gfx/2d/DrawTargetRecording.cpp:883 uses GetUnderlyingType(), and upstream uses GetUnderlyingType() == RECORDING for the same surfaces at :855): the GPU-side branch tests drawn->GetType() == SurfaceType::RECORDING, but a canvas recording wraps its snapshots with GetType() equal to CANVAS_RECORDING (gfx/layers/ipc/CanvasChild.cpp:139 in the source repository). Its GetUnderlyingType() is the RECORDING one, which is what DrawTargetRecording::StealthProjectedSurface checks and what its own comment says. So for those surfaces the GPU-side projection is never taken and the code falls back to a readback here. The pixels should match, but the intent (no readback per drawImage) is broken. The static_cast at :1559 is safe because only DrawTargetRecording overrides IsRecording() to true (gfx/2d/DrawTargetRecording.h:46). The over-80-column StealthNoise line is confirmed at :1558. Also an over-80-column line: the StealthNoise call. The page-facing wrapper (about 18 logic lines) can move to an own file behind a one-line hook. The DrawTargetRecording.h include sits before Document.h, out of order.

verifier.why: Checked the LIKELY BUG against the tree and confirmed it.

inventory.anchor: enum of RecordedEvent event types (after OPTIMIZESOURCESURFACE)
inventory.notes: Inserting the tag in the middle of the list renumbers LINK, DESTINATION, ACCESSIBLEID and every later tag. Content and GPU processes exchange these numbers, so both must come from the same tree (true for our build, not for a mixed pair). Appending the tag at the end would avoid the renumbering. Must match the X-macro entry in RecordedEventImpl.h.

verifier.why: This is the event tag of the canvas noise projection; sibling files RecordedEventImpl.h and DrawTargetRecording.* are spoof.

inventory.anchor: RecordedStealthProjectSurface (class, PlayEvent, Record, stream constructor) and the RECORDED_EVENT X-macro list
inventory.notes: The class and its templated Record and stream constructor must be visible where the X-macro expands.
